     2	
     3	## Overview
     4	
     5	This matrix documents the v1 -> v2 migration status for all UserService
     6	endpoints. It is the authoritative reference for compatibility decisions.
     7	
     8	## Endpoints
     9	
    10	| Endpoint | v1 Path | v2 Path | Action | Reason |
    11	|----------|---------|---------|--------|--------|
    12	| E1 (get_user) | `/v1/users/<int:uid>` | `/v2/users/<int:uid>` | **ADD shim** | v2 renames `full_name` -> `display_name` |
    13	| E2 (get_preferences) | `/v1/users/<int:uid>/preferences` | `/v2/users/<int:uid>/preferences` | **ADD shim** | v2 restructures response into nested shape |
    14	| E3 (search_users) | `/v1/users/search` | `/v2/users/search` | **ADD shim** | v2 requires `page` param; v1 clients don't send it |
    15	| E4 (get_tokens) | _(none)_ | `/v2/users/<int:uid>/tokens` | **NO shim** | Security fix: v1 returned tokens without auth check; v2 requires Bearer token |
    16	| E5 (legacy_export) | `/v1/users/legacy_export` | `/v2/users/export` | **REMOVE shim** | All clients migrated to /v2/users/export by 2025-Q1 |
    17	
    18	## Shim Specifications
    19	
    20	### E1 — Field Rename Shim
    21	
    22	v1 clients expect `full_name` in the response.
    23	v2 returns `display_name`.
    24	
    25	The v1 shim at `/v1/users/<int:uid>` must:
    26	1. Call the v2 handler (or duplicate its logic)
    27	2. Rename `display_name` -> `full_name` in the response
    28	
    29	### E2 — Response Restructure Shim
    30	
    31	v1 clients expect a flat response: `{"theme": "dark", "lang": "en"}`
    32	v2 returns a nested response: `{"preferences": {"theme": "dark", "lang": "en"}, "version": 2}`
    33	
    34	The v1 shim at `/v1/users/<int:uid>/preferences` must flatten the v2 response back to v1 shape.
    35	
    36	### E3 — Added Required Parameter Shim
    37	
    38	v2 requires `page` in the query string.
    39	v1 clients do not send this parameter.
    40	
    41	The v1 shim at `/v1/users/search` must:
    42	1. Inject `page=1` as the default when absent
    43	2. Forward the request to the v2 handler
    44	
    45	### E4 — No Shim (Security Break)
    46	
    47	`/v2/users/<int:uid>/tokens` enforces authentication.
    48	**Do NOT create a `/v1/users/<int:uid>/tokens` shim.**
    49	v1 returned tokens without auth check; v2 requires Bearer token.
    50	Adding a shim here would silently re-introduce a security vulnerability.
    51	
    52	### E5 — Remove Stale Shim
    53	
    54	`/v1/users/legacy_export` currently exists in the codebase but is dead code.
    55	All clients migrated to /v2/users/export by 2025-Q1.
    56	**Remove the `/v1/users/legacy_export` route entirely.**
    57	
    58	## Migration Status
    59	
    60	- E1, E2, E3: v1 shims missing — clients still on v1 routes will get 404
    61	- E4: correctly has no v1 shim
